about.metadataDescription: Presk is the AI-native productivity platform built by a distributed team.
about.title: Building the workspace teams deserve
about.description: Presk started with a simple belief: the tools teams use every day should feel like one product. We're a distributed team of builders, designers and researchers working to make that real.
about.valueClarityDescription: We build tools that make the state of the work obvious, so teams spend less time asking and more time doing.
about.valueAiDescription: Assistants should handle the busywork — summaries, updates and follow-ups — so people can focus on judgement.
about.valueWorkspaceDescription: Context shouldn't live in five tabs. Projects, chat, calendar and files belong together.

faq.metadataDescription: Answers about plans, security, the AI assistants and migrating your team.
faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started. Can't find what you're looking for?
faq.sectionDescription: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: How does the free plan work?
faq.a1: The Starter plan is free forever for up to 5 members and includes projects, tasks, messaging and 1 GB of storage. No credit card required.
faq.a2: Your Team trial lasts 14 days. When it ends you can pick a plan or drop back to Starter — your data stays intact either way.
faq.q3: How do the AI assistants fit in?
faq.a3: Assistants live inside your workspace. They can summarize threads, draft task updates and answer questions about your projects, files and calendar.
faq.a4: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and organizations include role-based access control. Enterprise adds SSO, SCIM and audit logging.
faq.q5: Can I import from other tools?
faq.a5: You can bring your team over quickly — invite members by email and import projects, files and calendars from common tools.
